title: Staff Research Engineer (LLM Pre-Training)
description: <p data-pos="0">At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started back in 2000, we have been striving to make the world’s most robust and effective developer tools. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p data-pos="284">We are working on an ambitious new platform that provides AI capabilities to all JetBrains products. Our platform is based on models developed in-house for writing and coding assistance, as well as integration with our strategic partners.</p> <p data-pos="524">We are looking for a Research Engineer who can contribute to training foundation models for coding tasks. You’ll be working on developing Large Language Models from scratch and deploying them into production environments where they will be accessible by end users across the globe.</p> <h3 data-pos="1515">We’ll be happy to have you on our team if you have:</strong> </h3> <ul data-pos="1570"> <li data-pos="1570">Experience in design, deployment, and support of production ML systems.</li> libraries for NLP.</li> <li data-pos="1816">Experience in distributed training of multi-billion parameter models.</li> <li data-pos="1888">Attention to detail in everything you do and great communication skills.</li> </ul> <h3 id="wed-be-especially-thrilled-if-you-have-experience-with" data-pos="1968"><strong data-pos="1970">We’d be especially thrilled if you have experience with:</strong> </h3> <ul data-pos="2030"> <li data-pos="2030">LLM inference frameworks such as vLLM, DeepSpeed, TensorRT.</li> <li data-pos="2092">LLM alignment techniques such as RLHF/RLAIF.</li> <li title: (Senior) Machine Learning Developer (Junie)
description: <p>Are you an engineer who loves diving deep into ML models, building standalone CLI tools, and exploring how far AI agents can go in autonomous coding? Do you want to rethink how software is built and use the tools you create every single day?</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We build Junie, our AI coding agent, available across JetBrains IDEs and as a standalone CLI. We're combining the latest advancements in AI and LLMs with our decades of software development expertise.</p> <p>We are working in three main areas: growing Junie CLI into a general-purpose agent independent of any IDE, optimizing model ensembling and setups for the best cost-to-intelligence ratio without compromising code quality, and pushing next-level autonomy so Junie can own, maintain, and evolve entire subsystems over multi-day horizons.</p> <p>You’ll have end-to-end ownership over these initiatives, taking work from early research to production code while shaping the future of autonomous development.</p> <p><strong>Day to day, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and ship new features for Junie across CLI and model integrations.</li> <li>Experiment with model setups, ensembling, and cost efficiency strategies.</li> <li>Build and test autonomous agent behaviors for long-term project maintenance.</li> <li>Own the full development cycle from initial research to production-ready code.</li> <li>Use Junie daily to continuously iterate on its quality and user experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Comfort taking full ownership of decisions and implementation.</li> <li>The curiosity to challenge assumptions and experiment with new ideas.</li> <li>The ability to learn new concepts quickly and adapt quickly.</li> <li>A mindset focused on long-term impact rather than short-term workarounds.</li> <li>Strong interest in autonomous AI systems and software engineering tools.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A proven track record of developing and shipping machine learning or full-stack software products.</li> <li>Hands-on experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, or agentic workflows.</li> <li>The ability to write high-quality production code across the full development lifecycle.</li> <li>Practical experience building or fine-tuning ML models.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>In this role, success means taking bold experiments in agent autonomy and cost efficiency and turning them into reliable, production-ready capabilities. You'll know you're succeeding when Junie can tackle complex multi-day engineering tasks autonomously and the tool you build every day actively improves your own engineering workflow.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Why join JetBrains? </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.</li> <li>Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.</li> <li>Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.</li> <li>Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities. title: Sr. Solutions Architect
description: <p><strong>REQ ID: FEQ427R344</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><strong> </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>Recruiter:</strong> Kanwal Matharu </p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> </p> <p>At Databricks, our core values are at the heart of everything we do; creating a culture of proactiveness and a customer-centric mindset guides us to create a unified platform that makes data science and analytics accessible to everyone. We aim to inspire our customers to make informed decisions that push their business forward. We provide a user-friendly and intuitive platform that makes it easy to turn insights into action and fosters a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement. </p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> </p> <p>You will be an essential part of this mission, using your technical expertise to demonstrate how our Data Intelligence Platform can help customers solve their complex data challenges. You'll work with a collaborative, customer-focused team that values innovation and creativity, using your skills to create customized solutions to help our customers achieve their goals and guide their businesses forward. </p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> </p> <p>You will engage with our largest and most complex customers across the region to advise them on adopting the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, in collaboration with a world-class, cross-functional team of Solutions Architects, Account Executives, and technology Specialists. You will work closely with a small group of customers and their account teams to help them respond to key business opportunities and challenges.</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> </p> <p>Join us in our quest to change how people work with data and make a better world!</p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> </p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Engage with some of Databricks’ most complex customers to help them achieve their unified platform goals.</li> <li>Develop and execute customer engagement strategies in partnership with the Account Executives and Solutions Architects in your designated accounts.</li> <li>You will coach core account teams and peers on positioning, adoption strategies and execution to achieve your outcomes in a defined timeline.</li> <li>You will influence stakeholders at all levels through complex engagements with the wider cloud ecosystem and 3rd party applications, ensuring they are excited by the Databricks vision and solution strategy.</li> <li>Be a 'champion’ for both customers and colleagues, operating as an expert solution architect and trusted advisor for significant data analytics architecture, design, and adoption of the Databricks Lakehouse platform.</li> <li>Contribute to Databricks' technical community engagement by developing customer-facing collateral and leading workshops, seminars, and meet-ups.</li> <li>Opportunity to continue your development in one of four tracks - technical specialization, industry vertical thought leadership, strategic customer vision, and people management.</li> </ul> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><br><br></p> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Know how to engage in complex customer interactions and sales lifecycle in a technical pre-sales capacity.</li> <li>You will have a technical background in Data Engineering or Data Warehousing (DWH) or a Machine Learning/AI background </li> <li>You will be working with our largest customers across all vertical sectors, focusing on establishing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform as their platform of choice.</li> <li>You will enjoy a high degree of autonomy and thrive in working with ambiguous requirements and challenging customer environments.</li> <li>Ability to influence influential decision-makers and C-level executives through developing relationships and orchestrating teams to achieve long-term success for customers.</li> <li>Prior experience with coding in a core programming language (i.e., Python or SQL) and willingness to learn a base level of Spark.</li> <li>Hands-on expertise with complex proofs-of-concept and public cloud platform(s) across AWS, Azure and Google.</li> <li>Know how to provide technical solutions for specialized customer needs and navigate a competitive landscape.</li> <li>Nice to have: Databricks Certification</li> <li>Up to 60% travel to London offices and customer site</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA) (Cloud Infrastructure)
description: <p><strong>ReqID:</strong><strong> FEQ427R340</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong><strong>London</strong></p> <p><strong>Skills: Networking, Security, Platform, DevOps, Databricks, Cloud - AWS, GCP, Azure, Infrastructure</strong></p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As an Infrastructure & Platform Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding enterprise customers through the architecture, administration, and security of their Databricks deployments on their cloud of choice (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This includes cloud-native IAM (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Google Cloud IAM), enterprise identity services (AWS IAM Identity Center, Entra ID, Google Cloud Identity), and federation standards (SCIM, OAuth, SAML, OIDC)</li> <li><strong>Networking & Deployments:</strong> Enterprise cloud networking (VPC/VNet design and peering, dedicated interconnects such as AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute / Google Cloud Interconnect, and private connectivity such as AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Link / GCP Private Service Connect), network routing, performance optimisation, and Terraform, plus cloud-native tooling such as AWS CloudFormation / CDK, Azure Resource Manager / Bicep, or Google Cloud Deployment Manager) to build, maintain, and scale complex cloud environments</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL: you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills</li> <li>Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms</li> <li>Proficient in the Databricks Platform</li> <li>Proven ability to lead architecture content, workshops, and community engagement</li> <li>Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences</li> <p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Databricks certifications</li> <li>Cloud provider certifications at professional level (e.g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Data Engineer; Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Professional Cloud Architect)</li> <li>Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, cloud-native data services, Azure Synapse, BigQuery) — understanding the landscape you'll position against</li> <li>Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. title: Product Manager, New Product Bet (Principal-level)
description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof. You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship. Why now Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it. The problem you're solving Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal. We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains: Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are. Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact. Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance. What you'll be doing Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them. Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact. Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on. Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it. Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation. Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion. Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring. Who you are You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes. You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along. You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask. You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes. You may be a good fit if you bring Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it. A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent. Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it. Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them. Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation. Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you. Location Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office. Our culture At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. Global benefits: You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity. You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays. Work from home budget Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year Generous referral scheme Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit) Benefits specific to UK: Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants 5% pension match Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description: About Level Zero Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we're pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health. Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are. We're seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we're assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions. We're looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the mechanical architecture of Level Zero's wearable medical devices, from early concept through to design transfer and volume manufacture. Working directly with the founding team and a multidisciplinary engineering group, you'll set the mechanical direction for highly miniaturised, body-worn products, making the key decisions on architecture, materials, manufacturing processes and risk. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who wants to own the mechanical design of a medical wearable end to end, while mentoring others and shaping how we develop products as we grow. What you'll do Own and lead the mechanical architecture of Level Zero's wearable medical devices. Drive miniaturisation and integration, working with electronics, sensing and industrial design to package complex functionality into small, comfortable, body-worn form factors. Set mechanical design standards, CAD practices, drawing conventions and design review processes for the engineering team. Lead the design of injection moulded, overmoulded and precision components from concept through to production release. Define mechanical requirements, design specifications and architecture documentation, and ensure traceability within the design history file. Lead tolerance analysis and statistical tolerancing for critical assemblies to ensure robust performance and manufacturability at scale. Own mechanical risk management, leading DFMEA activities and contributing to PFMEA and overall product risk files. Define and oversee verification and validation strategies, including reliability, environmental, ingress, drop, wear and life-cycle testing. Lead root cause investigations into complex mechanical failures and drive effective, data-led design improvements. Champion human-centred design, leading human factors studies, usability evaluations and user research, and ensuring wearability, comfort and ease of use are designed in from the start. Select and manage external suppliers, moulders, tooling vendors and contract manufacturers, and lead tooling trials, pilot builds and design transfer. Balance performance, usability, reliability, manufacturability, regulatory requirements and cost across the product lifecycle. The ideal candidate must have Master's degree with 4+ years of industry experience in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. A track record of taking medical devices or consumer wearables from concept through to volume manufacture. Experience leading the mechanical design of highly miniaturised or densely integrated products. Expert CAD and drafting skills, including complex assemblies and surfacing, with a strong command of engineering drawings, GD&T and manufacturing tolerances. Extensive experience designing injection moulded plastic components for volume manufacture, including overmoulding, multi-shot or insert moulding. Experience leading tolerance stack analysis and applying statistical tolerancing to critical assemblies. Experience designing sealed, leak-tight or ingress-protected assemblies and developing associated test methods. Strong knowledge of assembly methods including snap fits, heat staking, ultrasonic and laser welding, adhesives and overmoulding. Experience leading DFMEA, contributing to PFMEA and applying structured risk management in line with ISO 14971. Experience working within an ISO 13485 or equivalent quality system, including design controls, change control, product release and PLM systems. Experience defining and executing V&V plans and mechanical test methods. Experience managing external suppliers, tooling vendors and contract manufacturers, including tooling trials and production transfer. Proven ability to lead structured root cause analysis on complex mechanical failures. Experience designing products with user needs at the centre of development. Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews. Strong communication skills and the ability to influence across multidisciplinary engineering teams and with senior stakeholders. Nice to have: Experience designing skin-adhered or continuously worn medical devices (e.g. CGMs, patch pumps, cardiac monitors) Experience designing pumps, valves, diaphragms, microfluidics or other fluid-handling mechanisms Experience with IEC 60601, ISO 10993 biocompatibility or IEC 62366 usability engineering Experience designing precision mechanical mechanisms, such as applicators or insertion mechanisms Experience with sterilisation-compatible design and material selection Familiarity with Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical data analysis Experience with FEA for structural, thermal or fatigue assessment Experience with rapid prototyping, machining and 3D printing Prior work in a start-up or small company environment Experience building or scaling an engineering team Who You Are We value culture as much as we value technical expertise, creating an environment that's equal parts collaboration, curiosity, and fun. We're a fast-paced, mission-driven young team on a quest to make a lasting impact, fueled by uncompromising integrity, unwavering support for one another, and the thrill of exploring uncharted territories. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future. If our vision excites you, here are the qualities we look for: You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency. You're a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results. You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment. You're motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health. You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in. You're confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions. You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn What we offer A full-time role with a competitive salary and equity options, reflecting our value in your expertise and potential. An environment where you'll collaborate directly with the founding team at a leading biosensor startup, gaining access to industry experts and thought leaders. The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration. Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes. The excitement of working on cutting-edge technology, shaping strategic decisions, and driving innovation at an early-stage venture alongside a superstar team. Be Part of Our Journey If you're ready to be at the forefront of biosensing innovation and thrive in fast-paced, learning-rich environments, we'd love to hear from you. If your skills and experience do not align perfectly with this role, yet you believe you have something unique to offer, we're keen to listen. Reach out to us with a short statement on how you can contribute and let's discuss where you might fit into our team. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

ensure KPI definitions, tagging requirements and reporting cadences are agreed and maintained.</li> <li>Identify opportunities and risks from data (rank/visibility trends, CTR, crawl/indexation, content performance) and turn them into clear recommendations and prioritised tests.</li> <li>Oversee technical SEO health across client sites (crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, redirects, canonicals, hreflang), raising tickets and tracking delivery with dev/IT teams.</li> <li>Support content strategy and on-page optimisation: keyword and intent research, briefing, metadata, internal linking, information architecture, and content refresh programmes.</li> <li>Deliver GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) best practice by advising on content formats, entity/structured data signals, and brand presence in AI-assisted search experiences, while monitoring changes in SERP/AI features.</li> <li>Quality assure SEO deliverables prior to client submission (audits, reports, recommendations, briefs), ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment to brand and legal/compliance requirements.</li> <li>Oversee performance of all SEO/GEO activity and ensure learnings are incorporated into future plans; surface technical issues early and coordinate resolution across agency and client teams.</li> <li>Stay on top of platform updates (Google and other search engines) and wider industry trends, proactively sharing implications, opportunities and recommended actions with the team and the client.</li> <li>Partner with Planning and other channel teams (e.g., content, social, PR, paid search) to ensure SEO is aligned to the wider media strategy and integrated into campaign planning and measurement.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Essential personal qualities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Highly motivated and able to work and learn independently and as part of a team</li> <li>Ability to take responsibility for own work and to make sure that others deliver in support of you</li> <li>Flexibility - willingness to pick up tasks for others</li> <li>Quick to learn, and keen to develop</li> <li>Attention to detail</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.<br><br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Lead at the forefront of AI & Data Resilience</em></strong></p> <p>At Veeam, we don’t just talk about the future of technology — we are actively shaping it. title: Senior Partnerships Manager: Media & Editorial (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong> </p> <p>Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.</p> <p>This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.</p> <p>This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p><strong>Land flagship media partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.</li> <li>Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.</li> <li>Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build the publisher value proposition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.</li> <li>Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms</li> <li>Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing</li> <li>Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.</li> <li>Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.</li> <li>Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the technical and contractual path to live</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.</li> <li>Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global reach and internal leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.</li> <li>Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.</li> <li>Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.</li> <li>Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.</li> <li>Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (first 12 months)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume</li> <li>A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.</li> <li>A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.</li> <li>Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.</li> <li>Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.</li> <li>Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.</li> <li>An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.</li> <li>Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.</li> <li>Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.</li> <li>International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.</li> <li>Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.</li> <li>Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.</li> <li>Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.</li> <li>Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.</li> <li>Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.</li> <li>Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.</li> <li>Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.</li> <li>Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.</li> <li>Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.</li> <li>Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.</li> <li>Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.</li> <li>Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.</li> <li>Fluent English essential. title: [London] Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>As a Partners Solutions Architect on Anthropic's Applied AI team, you'll be a pre-sales architect focused on building technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You'll strengthen these relationships to accelerate indirect revenue, enable partners' AI practices, and execute our long-term go-to-market strategy.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Strategic technical partnership:</strong> Act as a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team. Bring technical expertise to help us understand the partner landscape, drive key strategic programs, and find ways to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. You'll also serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Joint solution development:</strong> Work with partners to identify high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions, and codify reference architectures and best practices that speed time to deployment.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Customer deal support:</strong> Step in to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner ecosystem and events:</strong> Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Product feedback:</strong> Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns. Deliver it to the relevant Anthropic teams to inform the product roadmap and partner strategy.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>You may be a good fit if you have</h3> <ul> <li> <p>5+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of partnering successfully with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery</p> </li> <li> <p>Exceptional ability to build relationships and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering and IT teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong presentation and technical communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools, or a background in machine learning or data science</p> </li> <li> <p>Enthusiasm for cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities</p> </li> <li> <p>A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed</p> </li> <li> <p>A passion for using technology in ways that are safe and beneficial, and that advance the goal of safe AI systems</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£150,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£190,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit <u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u> directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong> Learn about <a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our mission is to automate and optimise brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company.</p> <p>We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Job Description</strong></p> <p>We are currently expanding our operations throughout the UK and seeking a dedicated Field Service Technician to maintain installations for our customers in your area. This role will primarily involve working store opening hours but may include overnight work and attending installations where our product will be installed. As a crucial member of our team, you will assume accountability for the successful maintenance, deployment and adoption of our system. Physical stamina, proficiency with power tools, and the ability to meet quality and speed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are essential for this role.<br><br><strong>This will be a 6 Month contract position, working a minimum of 30 hrs per week with a possibility to extend beyond the initial contract.</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;"><strong><em>Possibility of weekend or night work</em></strong></li> <li style="font-style: italic; font-weight: bold;"><strong><em>Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to travel to sites is required.</em></strong></li> </ul> <p> <br><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Onsite and offsite maintenance of camera hardware: diagnose issues, install, replace and configure in accordance with company standards.</li> <li>Conduct routine preventative maintenance checks to identify and address potential issues.</li> <li>Respond promptly to service calls and ensure customer SLAs are met.</li> <li>Maintain accurate records of service activities, including work performed, parts used, and time spent, using company-provided tools</li> <li>Onboarding/scanning products into the system.</li> <li>As required, attend installations at various clients during night hours.</li> <li>Installation of Focal Systems product onto shelves, ceilings, and other equipment as per installation plans and specifications.</li> <li>Operate power tools safely and efficiently to complete installations.</li> <li>Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines to minimize risks during maintenance visits and installations.</li> <li>Work collaboratively with team members to ensure timely completion of installations.</li> <li>Maintain a high level of attention to detail to ensure maintenance tasks meet quality standards.</li> <li>Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently.</li> <li>Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members to provide updates on progress and address any issues or challenges encountered during store visits.</li> <li>Adhere to company policies and procedures at all times.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Field Service Technician Experience: Previous experience in a field technician role, preferably in field service, installation, construction, or a related field.</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues efficiently.</li> <li>Proficiency in using power tools and other installation equipment required for this type of role.</li> <li>Physical Stamina: Strong physical stamina to work on feet and perform physically demanding tasks for extended periods (up to 9 hours).</li> <li>Detail-Oriented: Excellent attention to detail to ensure maintenance work meets quality standards and adheres to specifications.</li> <li>Time Management: Ability to work well under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.</li> <li>Communication Skills: Effective communication skills to liaise with supervisors, team members, and customers, providing updates on progress and addressing any issues encountered during maintenance visits.</li> <li>Driver's License and Transportation: Valid driver's license and reliable transportation to travel to sites as required.</li> <li>Ability to work nights and weekends<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Focal Systems</strong></p> <p>Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.</p> <p>Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.</p> <p>Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong><strong><br></strong>We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:    </p> <ul> <li>Paid Time Off</li> <li>Pension</li> <li>Sick Leave</li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Executive
description: <h1>Senior Account Executive – Inizio Medical</h1> <p><strong>Manchester / Macclesfield/ London/ Hybrid</strong></p> <h2>The opportunity</h2> <p>Are you looking for a Senior Account Executive role that will give you exposure to the full breadth of medical communications?</p> <p>We're looking for an <strong>Senior Account Executive</strong> to join us working across an exciting mix of <strong>publications and Medical Affairs programmes.</strong></p> <p>This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who has built a foundation in medical communications and is ready to broaden their experience. You'll have the chance to develop across a varied portfolio of projects and build your career and experience.</p> <p>You'll join a collaborative team where you'll work with experienced client services and scientific colleagues. You'll have plenty of opportunity to develop towards the next stage of your career.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you will help deliver multiple medical communications projects from initiation through to completion.</p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Manage project activities, timelines, trackers and deliverables</li> <li>Work across a <strong>broad mix of publications and Medical Affairs projects</strong></li> <li>Support publications including <strong>abstracts, posters, manuscripts and congress activities</strong></li> <li>Deliver Medical Affairs initiatives such as <strong>advisory boards, scientific meetings, medical education and stakeholder engagement activities</strong></li> <li>Be an important contact for clients and build relationships</li> <li>Coordinate internal scientific, editorial, creative and client services teams</li> <li>Support project budgets, financial tracking and invoicing</li> <li>Identify potential risks or challenges and working with the wider team to find practical solutions</li> <li>Develop your understanding of client strategy and the wider objectives behind each programme</li> </ul> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who has:</p> <ul> <li>Previous experience within a <strong>medical communications agency or similar healthcare communications environment</strong></li> <li>Experience managing multiple projects and competing priorities</li> <li>Organisational and project management skills</li> <li>Confidence communicating with clients and team members</li> <li>An understanding of the medical communications project lifecycle</li> <li>Experience in <strong>publications and/or Medical Affairs</strong>, with an interest in developing across both</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused approach</li> </ul> <h2>Why join Inizio Medical?</h2> <p>You'll gain exposure to different project types, clients and ways of working, helping you build a rounded medical communications skill set.</p> <p>If you're ready to build on your medical communications experience and take the next step in a role offering <strong>breadth, responsibility and career development</strong>, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <p>At Inizio Medical, we believe our people are our strength. You'll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>A <strong>competitive salary and benefits package</strong>, including <strong>private medical insurance</strong> and a <strong>company pension</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Flexible, hybrid working</strong> options to support work-life balance.</li> <li>A <strong>friendly and inclusive culture</strong> with regular <strong>social events</strong>, <strong>wellbeing initiatives</strong>, and <strong>Town Hall events</strong>.</li> <li>Exceptional <strong>career development opportunities</strong> and access to world-class learning resources.</li> </ul> <p>We are proud to promote a culture of <strong>diversity, inclusion, and belonging</strong>. We believe our differences make us stronger — and that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and success.</p> <p>This is a hybrid remote/in-office role.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><em><img src="https://i.imgur.com/UuLTAa2.png" alt="disability confident committed" width="311" style="max-width: 100%;"></em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Working at CreateFuture</strong><br><br><a href="https://createfuture.com/" target="_blank">CreateFuture</a> is an <strong>AI-native consulting partner </strong>where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.<br><br></strong></p> <div class="_1bsb1osq _18s8y1gf _p12fukw8" data-testid="view-page-labels-container"> <div class="styles--2BkR3" data-ui="job-description"> <h3><strong>About the role and team:</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to own the technical direction of a data engagement, working with Microsoft Fabric, Python, and PySpark across our data team. You'll lead a team of data engineers, setting the standards for how pipelines and architecture are designed, built, and operated, while remaining hands-on with the most complex technical challenges. You'll work closely with client stakeholders and CreateFuture's wider engineering capability to ensure delivery is both technically excellent and commercially sound.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the technical direction of a data engagement, setting standards for pipeline architecture, data modelling, testing, and operational readiness</li> <li>Lead and technically direct a team of data engineers, allocating work, reviewing designs and code, and unblocking technical challenges</li> <li>Design and evolve data platform architecture on Microsoft Fabric, including data pipelines, Azure OneLake, and the broader Azure ecosystem</li> <li>Set and enforce CI/CD, testing, and operational practices across the engagement's data engineering workflows, using Azure DevOps</li> <li>Build professional relationships with key client stakeholders, translating business and data requirements into a coherent technical roadmap</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex issues in live data pipelines, and lead incident response when things go wrong</li> </ul> <h3><strong>We'd love to talk to you if you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Have extensive hands-on experience with a modern cloud data platform such as Microsoft Fabric (our current client's platform), Databricks, Snowflake, or Synapse, including designing production data platforms — the platform is the wrapper, not the skill, and strong engineering depth on one transfers readily to another</li> <li>Have deep SQL expertise and a strong grasp of data modelling and architecture (Kimball, data vault, medallion/lakehouse patterns, or domain modelling) — this is the clearest line between someone who operates a platform and someone who can design on top of it, and it's provider-agnostic</li> <li>Have strong proficiency in Python and PySpark for batch/ELT data processing at scale (this role centres on batch pipeline engineering — we treat streaming/real-time as a separate discipline and never assume the two are interchangeable)</li> <li>Have led or technically directed a team of data engineers, setting standards for pipeline design, testing, and delivery</li> <li>Have experience owning CI/CD and operational practices for data engineering workflows, ideally using Azure DevOps</li> <li>Are experienced working directly with client stakeholders, building trust and challenging where appropriate</li> <li>Have familiarity with the broader Azure ecosystem, including Azure OneLake and Azure ML, particularly for model industrialisation</li> </ul> </li> </ul> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 id="What-we’ll-offer-you:" data-renderer-start-pos="8044"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we’ll offer you:</strong></h3> <p>We trust people to title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation? What drives repeat usage, retention and churn? Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance? How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments? If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you. What you'll do Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation . Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding. Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist. Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics. Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value. Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities. Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes. Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted. Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement. You'll be great for this role if… You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis. You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value. You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation. You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them. You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use. You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence. You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making. You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style. This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. title: Data Engineer
description: Data Engineer London (Waterloo) · Full-time · Hybrid, three days per week in the office Who we are At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone. We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective. We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property. We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents. We’re looking for someone to own that foundation. The opportunity You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have. The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use. You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform. There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need. What you’ll do Own data as a product. Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable. Be opinionated about sources and quality. Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled. Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Ingest updates from sources such as HMRC and other relevant authorities, detecting changes promptly and turning them into usable, traceable data. Make data usable by our intelligence layer. Structure and serve information so our products and AI agents can retrieve the right facts in context.
